name: Natural PDF Workshop
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libgl1 libglib2.0-0 && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && ~/.local/bin/uv sync --frozen && ~/.local/bin/uv run python -m ipykernel install --user --name natural-pdf-workshop --display-name 'Natural PDF Workshop'
